said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text: On Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who answered the call to serve our nation. We recognize the dedication of our veterans and the support of their families. We owe our veterans the care and benefits they have earned through their service and sacrifice. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/F3wHVWdbu2

I was honored to join Midway and Lowe’s at a Red Vest Day event in celebration of this investment and in recognition of the partnerships dedicated to expanding opportunity and supporting our community in Douglas County. I look forward to seeing this work continue!
Congratulations to Midway Community Resource Center on receiving a Lowe's Community Impact grant! https://t.co/h9yGGhIC7K
I am grateful for the men and women who work around the clock to keep our district safe! https://t.co/nX8d22gLh3

Thank you to the Fulton County Emergency Services and Emergency Management for welcoming me on a tour of your departments. Seeing these vital services firsthand reinforces the importance of investing in preparedness and supporting the needs of communities in Fulton County.

I recently celebrated Georgia Pre-K Week by joining two reading events at Sheltering Arms Longview Center and Chattahoochee YMCA Head Start Academy. Thank you to the educators and caregivers investing in our youngest learners every day. Georgia’s future starts with them! https://t.co/z4DIRTmNj2

The Trump Administration has cut off all funding in the Bipartisan Safer Communities Law that was directly supporting programs to end this violence. America! We have to do more than pray—we need action. Enough is enough.
Our children are being killed by senseless mass shootings all across this country. https://t.co/KkMxUlJE8v

In the last year, TSA officers have been forced to work 88 days without on-time payment. Now, leadership has taken away their chairs.

It's not just about the chairs—it's about respect for every person on the job. I'm proud to lead House Dems in urging TSA to reverse its decision.
https://t.co/eB3fs1Qwmz

Domestic violence affects millions of people across our country, leaving lasting impacts on survivors, families, and communities. This Domestic Violence Awareness Month, I’m joining survivors and advocates in calling for action and change. Together, we can build safer communities.

As a two-time breast cancer survivor, Breast Cancer Awareness Month will always be close to my heart. I’ll continue fighting for more affordable, accessible health care and lifesaving breakthroughs. To every fighter and survivor: you are not alone. I stand with you.

As Hurricane Isaias continues to strengthen and make landfall late today, I want to thank the local meteorologists and public safety officials who are working around the clock to keep our region safe and prepared.

I encourage all Georgians to monitor updates and stay informed. Visit https://t.co/EuY7cNluKJ for the latest information from the National Weather Service, and be sure that you have a reliable way to receive warnings.
I am proud to represent young people interested in a career of service to our country. For more information and to submit your application, visit https://t.co/VHGixbY8Yr.

Are you a student in Georgia's Sixth District interested in attending a U.S. military service academy? Applications for a congressional nomination from my office are due no later than 11:59pm on Sunday, October 11, 2026.
For more information on submission guidelines, please visit https://t.co/OWkjSJb0yS. I look forward to seeing your apps!

Calling all GA06 Middle and High School students! Do you have an innovative idea? Are you interested in computer science, coding, and problem-solving with technology? Monday, October 26th is the deadline to submit your original apps for this year’s Congressional App Challenge.

My heart is with Vienna, Georgia. When violence comes to a small town, everyone knows someone who was lost, someone who was hurt, someone who is grieving.

I am thinking of every family, friend, and first responder today. These tragedies cannot continue.
Happy Hispanic Heritage Month! Join me during this time to honor the generations whose hard work, culture, and resilience have built America’s story. https://t.co/xpm1RDzOFG

Wishing a happy and sweet new year and a meaningful Rosh Hashanah to the Jewish community in Georgia’s 6th District and around the world. May the year ahead be filled with peace, joy, and new beginnings. https://t.co/PKsepoWo97

On the 25th anniversary of September 11, we pause to remember the lives lost and honor the heroes who risked everything to save others. We will never forget their courage, their sacrifice, or the resilience that carried our nation forward. https://t.co/pohfOy2nwg

This Labor Day, we honor the workers who keep our nation moving and make our communities stronger. Today is a reminder to continue fighting for fair wages, safe workplaces, and the dignity every worker deserves. https://t.co/UPcJVW0qZ0

I lost my son, Jordan, to gun violence. I am honored to have my story included alongside these families who have  bravely shared their experiences. Thank you, The Missing Word, for creating a space where our voice can be heard and where our children’s memories can be remembered.

I am deeply grateful to The Missing Word for including my story in this powerful book and for giving a name to a grief so many parents carry. This book highlights the stories of ollipsent parents and helps bring awareness to what is means to lose a child. https://t.co/WeR4TbGv0b

Rebranding discrimination bans to attack diversity efforts isn't justice or equality, it's erasure.

We refuse to let anyone erase American history.

topics.topic: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

posts.text:
For generations, people of color fought for the right to walk through doors that used to be closed.

The Supreme Court struck down segregation in the classroom. Now the Trump Admin wants to call that fight "discrimination" and use it to roll back the very progress we made.

topics.topic: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

posts.text: Congratulations to Congresswoman Analilia Mejia (NJ-11) and Congressman Everton Blair (GA-13) on being sworn in to the Congressional Black Caucus. Georgia and New Jersey are so lucky to have you. Your leadership will strengthen the work of the CBC and the communities you serve. https://t.co/NuzfxJhU1j

I remember being there with my family, who were active in the civil rights movement and taught me to participate in the fight for justice. Today, as attacks on voting and civil rights grow, it’s more important than ever to stay committed to protecting access and equality for all.

topics.topic: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

posts.text: Today marks 63 years since the first March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom. We honor the leaders, organizers, and those who demanded justice and helped pave the way for the Civil Rights Act and Voting Rights Act. Their fight built the foundation we stand on today. https://t.co/9mwmrtLCgX

topics.topic: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

posts.text: Dolly Parton embodied the spirit of our country and the best in all of us. Her immense philanthropic work, especially for children’s health and education, will continue to shape generations. From the Imagination Library to her quiet acts of giving, her legacy will endure. She will be sorely missed.

I am deeply saddened by the shooting at my alma mater Virginia State University. All students should be able to focus on their education without the threat of gun violence. 

I am praying for those students affected by this senseless act. VSU Trojans are strong and mighty. We will get through this together. I remain committed as ever to keeping all Americans safe.

As students across Georgia’s 6th District head back to school, I’m wishing everyone a safe and successful year ahead. Thank you to our dedicated parents, teachers, and school staff who make learning possible every single day. Here’s to a strong start and a wonderful school year! https://t.co/j5rWcota3k

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
